description: This file defines the `Prop` class within the `OrangeHRM\Core\Vue` namespace. The class encapsulates a property used for Vue.js component communication, including the property's name, type, and value, with methods to get and set these attributes and serialize the value to JSON.

classes.name: Prop
classes.description: A class representing a Vue.js property with type safety and JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the property with a name, type, and optional value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the property.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the property.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of the property, which can be any type.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets the raw value of the property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string representation of the raw value.
